title: Lesson 08: Night Mode
sources: Samsung Camera: in low light a moon icon with a number appears in Photo mode (creator's own screenshot); the phone must be held still while the night capture completes

lines.text: Night photos coming out dark and grainy?
In low light, look for the little moon icon.
That number is how many seconds it needs.
Tap it, then hold perfectly still until it finishes.
Brace your elbows, or rest the phone on something solid.
Stick to one x, the main camera gathers the most light.
Your night shots come out bright, clean, and sharp.
